repos_data.description: iOS Calabash Launcher is a macOS app that helps you run and manage Calabash tests on your Mac.

One MCP server, 51 tools for AI agents on mobile + canvas UIs: iOS & Android automation, Maestro E2E, evidenced assertions, React Native/Metro debugging — plus a no-vision canvas/WebGL brain (Pixi/Konva/Fabric/Phaser/Three/Babylon) that drives game UIs like DOM elements, ~5x cheaper than screenshot loops.
